/password/reset Direct On-Prem Prod on-prem beforeon-prem afterprod beforeprod after
2026-07-13 · Production · 211a326933 · Direct
What changed: Re-applies the cookie-bound password reset flow (SECURITY-1381): forgot-password, resend, PIN verify and final reset no longer carry the reset id/token in the URL or request body and instead rely on an HttpOnly session cookie, and the old id/token-based reset screens are removed.
What to test: Run the full Forgot Password flow (submit email, receive PIN, verify PIN, set new password) and confirm it completes end-to-end with no id/token appearing in any URL, that 'resend PIN' works and is rate-limited, and that the magic-link email lands you on the reset-complete screen.
2026-07-13 · On-Premises · f665a00138 · Direct
What changed: The on-prem forgot-password/PIN/reset flow is reworked to be cookie-bound: the reset session now rides in an HttpOnly 'pwreset_sid' cookie instead of an id/token in the URL, so the PIN and reset-password pages use clean URLs (/password/reset/pin and /password/reset/complete) and no longer carry id/token in their links or request bodies.
What to test: Run the full on-prem forgot-password flow end to end (request reset email, enter/resend the PIN, then set a new password including the MFA branch) and confirm the URLs contain no id/token, each step succeeds via the cookie, and an expired reset link shows the 'link has expired' error back on /password/reset.
